_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround air grid {width}x{height}.
Tha thu player {player_id}. Gluasaidhean dlùth: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' no w/s/a/d.
Amas: tha thu beò nas fhadhaiche na daoine eile. Tha lorgaichean marbh; tha buaidh bhalla a' marbhadh; tha tubaistean ceann-an-aghaidh a' marbhadh an dà chuid.

game_action.invalid_death: Bhàsaich cluicheadair {player_id} air sgàth gluasad neo-dhligheach.

outcome.survived_win: Choimhead cluicheadair {player_id} beò; thuit a h-uile duine eile.
outcome.outlived: Bha an cluicheadair a' fuireach nas fhaide na gach fear eile.
outcome.turn_limit: Tha crìoch cas a 'ruighinn - bidh am fear as fhaide beò a' buannachadh.
